hotel.name: The Ritz Carlton Bahrain Hotel & Spa

verified_facts.text: The hotel spans 70 acres of private beachfront around a lagoon in Manama.
verified_facts.excerpt: spans 70 acres of private beachfront around a picturesque lagoon

verified_facts.text: The Royal Beach Club offers access to a private beach, lagoon and marina.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Royal Beach Club offers access to a private beach, lagoon, and marina.

verified_facts.text: The three-bedroom villas have direct beach access and a private pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our 3 bedroom villas offer luxury accommodation, direct beach access and private pool

verified_facts.text: The Club Level is on the 6th and 7th floors and is described as a hotel within a hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the 6th and 7th floors, the Club Level offers the comfort, convenience, and intimacy of a hotel within a hotel.

verified_facts.text: The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Five times each day, the Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations.

verified_facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not give complimentary Club access.
verified_facts.excerpt: *Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to Club.

verified_facts.text: La Table Krug is described by the hotel as the region's first and smallest fine dining restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: La Table Krug arrives as the region's first and smallest fine dining restaurant.

verified_facts.text: Nirvana is a fine dining Indian restaurant with kebabs, grilled seafood and live traditional music.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reflecting the decadent décor of India’s palaces, this fine dining restaurant offers authentic dishes, including kebabs and grilled seafood, accompanied by live traditional music.

verified_facts.text: Cantina Kahlo is a Mexican restaurant with decor inspired by Mexico's art scene.
verified_facts.excerpt: authentic Mexican restaurant in Manama, Bahrain, with décor inspired by Mexico's vibrant art scene

verified_facts.text: Plums is a modern steakhouse whose specialties are premium cuts of meat and fresh seafood.
verified_facts.excerpt: this modern steakhouse offers dishes as rich as the décor itself. Premium cuts of meat and fresh seafood are the specialties.

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea is served daily in the Lobby Lounge, with a classical duo playing.
verified_facts.excerpt: exquisite melodies from a classical duo provide the perfect environment in which to relax over a world-famous Ritz-Carlton afternoon tea. The traditional high tea is served daily

verified_facts.text: Ta Plage Privée is on the resort's private island and offers an air-conditioned private tent, a dedicated massage room and an exclusive beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: With an air-conditioned private tent where you can relax, along with a dedicated massage room and your very own exclusive beach

verified_facts.text: The spa uses Dead Sea minerals and has a thalassotherapy pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minerals from the Dead Sea and our authentic thalassotherapy pool are among the water-inspired elements at this luxury spa in Bahrain.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers Valmont facials and ESPA wellness treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: We feature a luxury experience with Valmont facials and Wellness with ESPA

verified_facts.text: The Royal Beach Club has a Turkish hammam with four plunge pools at different temperatures, plus a steam room and sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Traditional Turkish Hammam consisting of four plunge pools set at different temperatures

verified_facts.text: The minimum age to enter the spa is 16.
verified_facts.excerpt: Minimum age for guest to enter the spa is 16 years old.

verified_facts.text: Ritz Kids welcomes children aged 4 to 12 to join its activities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children aged 4 to 12 are welcome to join our exciting activities.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Beach Club has three floodlit tennis courts and an air-conditioned squash court.
verified_facts.excerpt: Royal Beach Club’s three floodlit tennis courts with superb surfaces promise exhilarating play, while the air-conditioned glass-backed squash court offers the indoor alternative.

verified_facts.text: The resort's Pearl 1 boat runs daily sea excursions along the coast, including dolphin watching.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take to the sea on our resort’s Pearl 1 boat for daily excursions that will have you exploring hidden enclaves, cruising the kingdom’s coastline, watching beautiful dolphins, and more.

verified_facts.text: During Ramadan, the hotel's restaurant operations change.
verified_facts.excerpt: During the Holy Month of Ramadan, we would like to inform you that there are changes to our restaurant operations.

verified_facts.text: The Royal Beach Club is reserved exclusively for hotel guests and members.
verified_facts.excerpt: Reserved exclusively for hotel guests and members, the club offers a marina
